interpretation: 状态色随余量连续插值；图片附色带示意。

jobs.name: 浅色原生
jobs.style: Theme A. Keep cool pearl canvas #e8edf2 and porcelain surface #fafbfc, clear cool-gray borders and Segoe-like sans. Original blue-native visual character stays in toolbar/neutral furniture; semantic quota colors now follow continuum. Compact uses its original thin HORIZONTAL progress track at bottom: only a short 8% coral segment at LEFT; 8% large numeral coral-red. Expanded retains left-aligned large quota number, period/reset to the right, full-width horizontal main track with only 8% left fill, weekly row amber 24%, two-column stats band and side-by-side line charts. Calm, highly readable light native utility. Low-state warning panels have only very faint coral tint.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit. Using the TWO provided reference images as the authoritative visual identity and layout reference, create ONE low-quota-state presentation image for this same Windows desktop widget Remaining Margin Float. Reference image 1 = compact widget, reference image 2 = expanded details. Preserve their distinctive typography, geometry, spacing, theme surfaces, toolbar, stats grouping and chart composition. Change quota state and its semantic colors, not the product design.
Composition: horizontal high-resolution 1536x1024-style presentation canvas. LEFT: one compact square widget enlarged to about 280x280 px, labeled '紧凑布局 · 放大示意'. RIGHT: one full expanded details window around 600x780 px, labeled '详情布局'. Large legible Chinese, flat front facing, no perspective, no device frames. BOTH show exactly the SAME current main quota '8%' and label '5 小时余量'. Compact remains a practical 80x80 logical-pixel square, only Codex, 8%, period label, and its signature progress indicator; no extra metrics in compact. Details retain original reference design and show provider 'Codex', badge 'Plus', '本机账户', small collapse chevron in top-right.
Quota consistency is essential: ALL main progress indicators must show just EIGHT PERCENT remaining, 92% neutral used track. Main low-quota value 8% uses a readable warm warning color. Secondary weekly quota is '24%' with exactly 24% remaining, on its OWN intermediate amber color from same continuum, not red just because main quota is low. Reset text '16:20 重置 · 3 小时 8 分钟后'. Weekly row '每周余量' '24%' '6 天 9 小时后重置'. Keep sample token stats '今日 Token' '382.6K' '输出 81.4K', '今日缓存' '245.8K' '命中率 64.2%'. Trend title '5 小时额度趋势'. Replace safe-state reassurance with a small warning triangle and text '预计约 45 分钟后耗尽'. Two descending mini charts: '近 5 小时' '78% → 8%' and '近 7 天' '91% → 8%'. Both chart endpoints must be near the 0% baseline at 8%, NOT in the middle of graph. Existing bottom status line becomes '余量偏低 · 低于 20% 提醒阈值', small warning icon, pale theme-appropriate warning tint. Keep footer '本地会话 · 刚刚更新', '刷新', 'v1.13.3'. No green shield or '不会耗尽' text. All data fictional, include '演示数据' discreetly outside UI.
COLOR BEHAVIOR: As quota decreases continuously from 100% to 0%, current status color smoothly interpolates through the specified theme-specific anchors, with NO abrupt jumps. Actual indicator fill at this moment is a single near-uniform color corresponding to 8%; do NOT draw a rainbow inside the 8% progress segment, do NOT fill 92%, and do NOT recolor every panel red. Progress quantity and color are separate. Tiny chart strokes MAY smoothly transition from normal at older high values to warm warning at current low values. Labels and footer remain high-contrast neutral.
At the very BOTTOM of the PRESENTATION CANVAS, OUTSIDE both app windows, add a thin clean horizontal continuous gradient legend, labeled '余量颜色连续过渡', with anchor labels '100%' '60%' '30%' '15%' '0%' from LEFT to RIGHT. Small unobtrusive marker at 8%, close to right end, text '当前 8%'. This legend explains the color system and is not an app control. Leave enough room so UI and legend never overlap. No extraneous widgets, no website chrome, no big marketing copy.

jobs.name: 深色仪表
jobs.style: Theme B. Keep graphite canvas #14191c, opaque graphite window #22292b, secondary #2a3335, off-white text #edf2ef, restrained no-glow instrument style, thin borders and structured grid, tabular numbers. Signature CIRCULAR gauge in compact and expanded: eight percent is ONLY a tiny 28.8-degree coral arc starting at 12 o'clock clockwise, remaining 331.2 degrees is muted gray. Compact must be VERTICAL CENTERED STACK: Codex above ring, 8% inside ring, 5 小时余量 below. No side-by-side compact, no second compact progress bar. Expanded ring on left with label and reset to right, weekly amber horizontal line24%, two flat stats columns, two structured step-line charts. Keep dark surfaces dark; small warning strip has a restrained deep reddish tint, never bright red panels.

jobs.name: 柔和纸感
jobs.style: Theme C. Weekly light-tinted band now muted ochre24%, open two-column stats, two minimal area charts sharing an open background. Low-state 8% numeral in muted clay red with sufficient contrast; very subtle clay-tinted warning strip, preserve gentle paper-like calm.
